name: Bibb County, GA
findings: Bibb County has 675 nonprofit organizations. 279 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 230 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bibb County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
